column1: # Split git layout file-writer census (Wave B PR 5 lane 5e, spec §9 option B). test/split-layout-writer-census.test.ts counts each src file's file write primitives.
# Classes: door (writes under the publication door or moves whole checkout trees), split_aware (plans or writes a split unit through the split helpers),
# refuse_before_write (refuses a split write before its first database or file write), not_page_path (never writes a checkout page path; the rationale says how that is known).
# A split_aware or refuse_before_write writer names assertSplitWritable (or splitWriteRefusal, oneFileWriteRefusal, assertPageThroughWritable); a rationale starting "no helper:" says why it cannot.
